title: law-losangeles-1998-skyweight
label: "Dangerous" Devon Case

won.source: Already champion entering the earliest attestation in the held record (14 September 1999); no document in the held record records when or how he won it.

note: Billed against "The Cornerstone" Jeffrey Drake at the promotion's own Breakdown card on 19 September 1999; per the challenger's own account, the champion avoided a clean finish and kept the title, provoking a rematch challenge for 3 October 1999 whose own outcome does not survive this collection.
